admin.name: Name
admin.deleteBody: This removes their account, their uploaded files and Imports, and their own Diver with all Dives. It can’t be undone. To keep the data, disable the User instead.

admin.revokeBody: The link stops working. You can invite them again with a new link.
admin.disableBody: They can’t sign in anymore and are signed out everywhere. Their data stays, and you can enable them again.
admin.signOutBody: All their sessions end. They can sign in again.

siteImport.title: Import dive sites
siteImport.intro: Fetch dive sites from open data into this Dive Hub. Sites that are already here are updated where nobody changed them; what Users changed stays.
siteImport.adminLead: Fill the dive sites with open data from OpenStreetMap and Wikidata, for a country, an area or everywhere.
siteImport.odblTitle: OpenStreetMap’s data comes with conditions (Open Database License).
siteImport.odblCredit: Wherever its data is shown, OpenStreetMap must be credited. Dive Hub does this on every site that has its data and on the list of dive sites.
siteImport.odblShareAlike: If you make the list of dive sites available to the public, you must offer it under the same license. A Dive Hub only invited people use, such as a family’s or club’s, doesn’t do that.
siteImport.odblConfirm: I understand and import OpenStreetMap data under these conditions
siteImport.boxHint: Degrees; south and west are negative.
siteImport.languageHint: Where a source has names in several languages (Wikidata). OpenStreetMap’s local names are kept.
siteImport.needBox: Enter all four edges, with the south edge below the north edge.
siteImport.needOdbl: Confirm the conditions of OpenStreetMap’s data, or import from Wikidata only.
siteImport.busy: An import is running. Start the next one when it’s done.

ssi.title: SSI
ssi.intro: Send your dives to your SSI logbook (the MySSI app). Dive Hub signs in to SSI for you. SSI has no official interface for this, so sending can stop working whenever SSI changes its app.
ssi.tokenOnly: This server doesn’t keep passwords. Dive Hub keeps only your SSI sign-in, which can expire at any time; then you sign in here again.
ssi.keepHint: Dive Hub keeps your SSI password, encrypted, and signs in again by itself when SSI asks.
ssi.dontKeepHint: Dive Hub keeps only your SSI sign-in. It can expire at any time; then you sign in here again before sending.
ssi.disconnectBody: Dive Hub forgets your SSI sign-in and password. Dives already in SSI stay there, and their history stays here.
ssi.signInNeeded: SSI wants you to sign in again.
ssi.goSignIn: Sign in to SSI again in your account
ssi.needsSite: To send this dive to SSI, choose its dive site first.
ssi.needsSsiSiteId: To send this dive, {{site}} needs SSI’s ID for the site.
ssi.deleteBody: SSI dive {{number}} disappears from your SSI logbook, and SSI’s app can’t bring it back. The dive stays here, and you can send it again.
ssi.unconfirmedNote: SSI shows dives sent from Dive Hub as unconfirmed: only a dive center can confirm a dive there.
